shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Restrained shared header, chip and contact-action depth.

shadows.name: glass-deep
shadows.purpose: Hero, panes, project surfaces and contact panel.

shadows.name: project-hover
shadows.purpose: Active preview on eligible fine-pointer hover.

motion.name: hero-sequence
motion.purpose: Authored initial hero, completed by the second decorative pane.

motion.name: hero-actions
motion.purpose: Entrance relinquishes transform after completion for hover/press.

motion.name: about-scroll
motion.purpose: Bounded 3% entrance; factual paragraphs stay still.

motion.name: ambient
motion.purpose: Local hero light drift; paused offscreen/hidden.

motion.name: reflection
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer glass reflection; skipped for touch/reduced motion.

motion.name: glass-depth
motion.purpose: Bounded hero/contact tilt; skipped for touch/reduced motion.

motion.name: skill-lift
motion.purpose: Static chips on fine-pointer hover only with normal motion.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Hover excludes :active; reduced motion removes press transform.

motion.name: contact-lift
motion.purpose: LinkedIn action on eligible fine-pointer hover.

motion.name: project-lift
motion.purpose: Active preview only, eligible fine-pointer hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Immediate rail commits, visible reveals, no spatial effects/smooth scrolling/animations/transitions.

materials.name: opaque-fallback
materials.value: #f4f9fc without blur under reduced transparency; primary CTA retains #0764bb with white text; solid fallback also covers unsupported blur

layout.name: education
layout.purpose: Separate full-width section; 62px separation and stacked flat rows ≤900px.

narrative.northStar: A clear engineering record in blue light.
narrative.overview:
The portfolio combines Apple-inspired editorial hierarchy with bright white frosted glass and blue-cyan light. Large, tightly tracked Geist headings establish pace; open charcoal reading rows keep the professional record legible. Cyan, mint and faint lavender soften the established blue atmosphere without changing its material values.

A quick staged hero reveal leads into a large research-to-practice statement, a flat timeline, immersive project placeholders, full-width grouped skills, separate academic rows and a luminous contact close. Motion is selective and bounded: factual paragraphs stay still, navigation contracts with scroll direction, and decorative loops pause outside the hero or when the document is hidden.
keyCharacteristics: Established blue/cyan light, mint support and a faint lavender accent on white.
Self-hosted Geist at 400, 500 and 600, with editorial scale and tracking no tighter than −.04em.
Bright frosted glass, clear blue actions and restrained blue depth on selected surfaces.
One visible hero name, a discreet Portfolio. navigation label and explicit project placeholders.
Flat factual rows, four skill groups, separate Education and preference-aware motion.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Use deep blue for reading text on pale glass and white text on the primary blue action; reserve lighter blue and cyan for material and light.

rules.name: The Weight Roles Rule
rules.body: Use 400 for reading copy, 500 for actions and chronology, and 600 for headings; preserve the source’s role-specific size and line-height relationships.

rules.name: The Visible Record Rule
rules.body: Keep every responsibility visible and every matching credential available without an expansion step; filters refine the reading list rather than gate it.

rules.name: The Selective Glass Rule
rules.body: Apply visible glass to the header, hero, actions, project previews, individual skill chips and contact; retain flat groups and rows for skills categories, experience, education and credentials.

dos: **Do** keep the full visible name in the hero and use Portfolio. as the navigation label.
**Do** preserve the established blue light, bright glass, cyan/mint support and dark reading text.
**Do** retain the editorial Geist hierarchy, complete responsibilities, four flat skill groups and separate Education.
**Do** keep project placeholders explicit and preserve the authorised one-panel rail.
**Do** retain visible focus, named search, live counts and usable anchors at every breakpoint.
**Do** keep reveals visible under reduced motion and print all 17 credentials independently of filters.
donts: **Don't** turn factual sections into glass cards or nest chips inside glass category cards.
**Don't** use saturated ambient colour for small reading text or give static skills button semantics.
**Don't** hide responsibilities in disclosures or credentials behind show-more controls.
**Don't** invent project names, clients, results or claims from placeholder artwork.
**Don't** make motion, blur or hover a prerequisite for reading or interacting.
